title: Canada's Leylah Fernandez wins Singapore Open for 1st title of season
summary: Canada's Leylah Fernandez captured her first title of the season with a 7-5, 6-0 win over Australia's Talia Gibson in the women's singles final at the Singapore Tennis Open on Sunday.

image.caption: Canada's Leylah Fernandez celebrates after beating Australia's Talia Gibson 7-5, 6-0 to win the WTA Singapore Tennis Open on Sunday. (Rahman/AFP via Getty Images)

blocks.text: Canada's Leylah Fernandez captured her first title of the season with a 7-5, 6-0 win over Australia's Talia Gibson in the women's singles final at the Singapore Tennis Open on Sunday.
Laval, Que., native tops Australia's Talia Gibson in straight sets for 6th career title
The Laval, Que., native won the last nine games to secure the win in one hour 38 minutes. Fernandez dropped only one set across her five matches in the tournament.
It marks the sixth career title for Fernandez, whose last triumph came at the Japan Women's Open last October. All of her titles have been earned in hard-court tournaments.
Fernandez improved to 6-3 in final appearances and now has two WTA 500 titles, having previously won the D.C. Open in July 2025.
